description: Specification for interactive teaching pages that the host agent generates. The MCP server only returns this specification and never writes front-end code itself.

constraints.no_cdn: Every page must run offline. Do not rely on network fetches at runtime.
constraints.no_tailwind_cdn: Use hand-written inline CSS with the design tokens below.
constraints.no_katex_or_mathjax: Render formulas with native MathML or inline SVG.
constraints.no_pyodide: Simulate code execution with a pure-JS controlled engine scoped to the exercise type, and state that scope in the UI.

layout.paragraph_readability: Use columns, subsections, diagrams and comparison panels instead of a narrow whole-page cap.
layout.mobile_rule: stack panels and keep page scrollWidth <= viewport width; code/table panels may scroll within their own container

required_components.description: Three-level progressive disclosure aligned with section 12.
rules: Level 1 is a guiding question, not the answer.
Level 3 is a partial derivation or worked example.
Every reveal is logged with its hint_level.
Always submit the raw answer text.
Report the hint level that was in effect when the answer was produced.
May be omitted entirely in P0; if present, store as predicted_performance.

required_components.description: A variation task that changes wording, parameters or scenario.

output_contract.assessment_confirmation: All local assessments remain provisional, including hosted ones, until Runtime confirms them. Never derive evidence_stage or mastery locally.

accessibility: All interactive controls reachable by keyboard.
Colour is never the only signal of correctness.
host_workflow: Check the MCP connection with get_available_actions; a copied schema is not a live connection.
Read authoritative domain sources with host tools, save source locators, excerpts, claims and worked checks through save_benchmark_report. Do not self-enable skipping.
Independently solve each question; check assumptions, boundary cases, uniqueness/equivalent options, expected answer, feedback and counterexamples.
Register each item using save_assessment_item before presenting it. Keep its returned item_id in page events.
Hydrate from real get_teaching_context, execute outbox calls in order, resolve attempt_id references, require ok=true, refresh Runtime context after commits.
Reassess free-text reasoning semantically on the host; Runtime normalises submitted scores and does not judge mathematics.
On item_completed execute check_advance_unit, then propose advance_unit only if the guard allows it.
Report source/content audit, browser scenarios and actual MCP integration separately. No claim of exam alignment without a dated syllabus source.

forbidden: claiming sampled numerical checks prove a statement for all x
claiming source review or exam frequency without evidence
marking a lesson complete merely after revealing an answer

teaching_depth.prerequisites: Teach the prerequisite needed for this step, not merely its name; explain terms, notation, units and input constraints.
teaching_depth.principle: Explain why it works and the conditions that make the claim true. No unsupported universal promise that every beginner has mastered it.
teaching_depth.steps: An ordered list of at least two complete operations or derivation steps with explanations; no 'obvious', 'similarly' or omitted intermediate result in place of teaching.
teaching_depth.worked_example: State the exact inputs and assumptions, show all steps and independently check the result.
teaching_depth.misconceptions: Give the incorrect idea, explain its error and repair it; never score prose by the presence of those words.
teaching_depth.boundaries: Cover zero/negative/empty/undefined inputs and domain-specific model limits that apply; avoid claiming an irrelevant case is supported.
teaching_depth.comparison: Contrast a correct method or condition with a nearby case for which it fails.
teaching_depth.practice: Provide basic, variation and challenge tasks with complete solutions and wrong-answer explanations.
teaching_depth.transfer: Change inputs, context or constraints; ask the learner to explain which principle carries over.

visualization.priority: visual first where a picture reveals structure, mechanism or state
visualization.no_visual_exception: Record an explicit pedagogical reason for a nonvisualizable point, not a blanket omission.
visualization.truth_boundary: Graphs and sampled simulations illustrate; analytical reasoning or full checks establish conclusions.

layout.paragraph_readability: Use columns, subsections, diagrams and comparison panels instead of a narrow whole-page cap.
layout.mobile_rule: stack panels and keep page scrollWidth <= viewport width; code/table panels may scroll within their own container

learning_resources.placement: At the top of each teaching document, before lesson content
learning_resources.prefer: Precisely relevant videos only after verifying URL accessibility, title/publisher, actual topical content and a useful timestamp or section.
learning_resources.unverified_video_rule: Omit the video completely; no guessed title, invented URL or availability guarantee.
learning_resources.fallback: Use precise topic + skill/operation + level search terms, with separate core/extension/advanced suggestions; label them as queries rather than sources read.
learning_resources.no_future_guarantee: Verification describes the checked moment only; every later generation rechecks or falls back to keywords.

canonical_source.states: Learner state in Markdown is explicitly a Runtime snapshot, never authoritative local mastery.
canonical_source.coverage: Compare visible teaching prose and formulas, not HTML/CSS/JS character count. Keep all projected content plus additional original explanation and examples in Markdown.
